composition_subtypes.role: Sort all liquid characters by density in ascending order (lowest density first) to simulate floating to top and left.

payload.core_composition_summary: Single-phase algorithm: flatten 2D array, sort elements by density using custom key, then reshape to original width.
payload.rationale: The solution relies solely on a sorting step with a density-based key. No data structures synergistically combine with sorting; it's a straightforward sort-and-reshape.
